title: chore(qa): drop the obsolete stale-prose NOTE from records-forms.action-location-matrix once PR #7540 lands
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#7540

One-line follow-up surfaced by #7420's dev report (a consequence of that fix landing, not a pre-existing defect — deliberately kept out of PR #7540, whose file surface was pinned to the showcase actions file).

## Task

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, item `records-forms.action-location-matrix`: the second `source` entry carries an inline NOTE saying RecalcSelectionAction's TSDoc "still narrates the pre-objectui#3142 rule - stale prose, filed separately". #7323 added that as an explicit temporary marker "until this card is worked". PR #7540 rewrites that TSDoc, so the NOTE becomes false the moment it merges. Delete the NOTE clause from the source string (one-line edit; keep the source citation itself).

## Provenance

- #7420 (the TSDoc card) → PR #7540 (the fix this note points at)
- #7323 (the checklist-side inversion that planted the marker)

Filed by the `domain:devx` execution seat (session `session_01GZKbx4xyF7U5WXj6ch49BM`) per the linkage-chore rule (issues, not memory). No `domain:*` label applied — routing is the triage seat's single-producer territory; `pm:blocked` + the `Blocked-by:` line above keep it out of selection until #7540 merges.
